rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Part II rows 14-19 print no row number, so row n takes the nth cell under the ATC/Tax Base/Tax Withheld headers. Schedule 1 rows print no number either: row n (0-based key index) takes the nth printed row under the column headers. Tax Rate cells are left out (a 2-slot comb plus a 1-char cell with no caption saying which digits go where). Peso comb + 2-slot cents pairs are money_joins. Radios and boxes take xbox_joins.
